NOTE
**Still not ready — the earlier PR #37289 is still claimed by a maintainer**

New: The author updated the description with the prior-work details and credit, and cross-referenced #37289, but there is no new push, and it is a repeat ping. Missing: agreement from @prakhar1144 (assigned to #37289, who said on 2026-09-04 he would finish it) or @CerealNotFound that this PR replaces it, and the light and dark theme screenshots promised in the issue plan (only one screenshot is posted).

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask prakhar1144 whether this PR should replace #37289. If so, hand it to him for "maintainer review" once the screenshots are added.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for updating the description. #37289 is still assigned to @prakhar1144, who planned to finish it, so please confirm with him and @CerealNotFound that this PR should replace it, as described in the [continuing unfinished work guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html). Please also add before/after screenshots in both light and dark themes.
```
